inputs.text: Vertical over-lap medium close shot of Lin Xiaoyu on the bed browsing a social profile. Premium handcrafted 3D plush doll, romantic warm night lighting, physically natural hands, no visible interface, no text. Animate only the following controlled action. Start: she sits cross-legged with a phone held upright toward herself. Action: her eyes scan downward, she performs one small pinch-to-zoom gesture on the hidden screen, then lifts her eyebrows and speaks. End: she studies the phone with a fond smile. Motion is slow and precise. Preserve the exact first-frame composition, character identity, outfit, props, and room. The camera stays locked and stable. She speaks softly to the phone with curious, amused lip movement.
